content:
Integrating with respect to \(y\), solve each curve for \(x\):

\[
x=\frac{y^2}{2}, \qquad x=y+4
\]

For \(-2 \le y \le 4\), the line is to the right of the parabola, so

\[
\text{Area}=\int_{-2}^{4}\left((y+4)-\frac{y^2}{2}\right)\,dy
\]

\[
=\left[\frac{y^2}{2}+4y-\frac{y^3}{6}\right]_{-2}^{4}
\]

\[
=\left(8+16-\frac{64}{6}\right)-\left(2-8+\frac{8}{6}\right)
\]

\[
=\frac{40}{3}-\left(-\frac{14}{3}\right)=18
\]

\[
\boxed{18}
\]
